title: 來了這個棉花糖： 「妳有想過嘗試翻唱Holomen的原創歌曲嗎？ 如果把帥氣的樂曲改編成咪口風格，不知道會變成什麼樣子呢，讓人很好奇⋯」 💬有人回了 Stellar Stellar…
context:
來了這個棉花糖：

「妳有想過嘗試翻唱Holomen的原創歌曲嗎？
如果把帥氣的樂曲改編成咪口風格，不知道會變成什麼樣子呢，讓人很好奇⋯」

💬有人回了 Stellar Stellar。

🌸：Stellar Stellar？wwww， 不是有在Sololive 上唱過了嗎？跟彗醬一起唱的，那時miComet推的人都爆炸啦！BANG～～～！都能想像成宇宙（大爆炸？）了啦！

*********************************************************

🌸：那個啊⋯彗醬之前出的那首辣妹⋯辣妹街的曲子，曲名是什麼啊？啊挖給？

（💬開始刷AWAKE⋯）

🌸：我完全唸不出來啊。最近彗醬的曲子也太多英文了吧，真的好難。什麼？你說應該要怎麼唸？

（💬試著教🌸正確唸法。🌸的眼睛開始看留言。）

🌸：啊哈哈哈哈！是ㄜ為可啊！啊哈哈哈哈！（笑得很開心。）原來如此！

💬：原來妳不會唸啊。

🌸：對啊我不會唸！ㄜ為可！⋯⋯ （🌸突然開始唸一串沒人聽得懂的櫻語⋯）

🌸：真是的，歌詞都不會唸啦，彗醬！
歌詞都唸不出來啦！
咪口真的是⋯很困擾啊！
捏⋯！

A marshmallow came that said:

“Have you ever thought about covering an original song from Holomen?
I’m curious about how a cool song would sound if arranged in Miko’s style…”

In 💬, Some people replied with Stellar Stellar.

🌸: Stellar Stellar? www, didn’t I already sing that at the Sololive? I sang it together with Suichan! That time, all the miComet fans went crazy! BANG～～～! I could totally imagine the universe ! (The Big Bang ?)

🌸: That song… that gyaru…gyaru machi one Suichan released before… What was it called again? Ah..wa…ge?

(💬starts spamming AWAKE…)

🌸: I can’t pronounce it at all. Lately, Suichan’s songs have way too much English; they’re so hard! Huh? You’re saying it should be pronounced how?

(💬tries to teach 🌸 the correct pronunciation. 🌸 starts looking at the comments.)

🌸: Ahahahaha! So it’s Ae-way-ke! Ahahahaha! (laughing happily) I see!

💬: So you didn’t know how to pronounce it, huh?

🌸: Yeah no, I didn’t! Ae-way-ke! … (🌸 suddenly starts saying a bunch of incomprehensible “Sakura language”…)

🌸: Seriously… I can’t pronounce the lyrics at all… Suichan! I can’t pronounce the lyrics! Miko is really struggling here! Nye…!
